header.running_head: Spying to Discover Faults in Muslims

blocks.text: The old man then said to Hadhrat Umar (RA) "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! Bring your ear closer to me". He then whispered in Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s ear saying, "Listen! I swear by the Being Who has sent Muhammad ﷺ as a Rasul with the truth that upto the time that I have come to this gathering, I have never repeated myself." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then raised his voice saying, "Allaahu Akbar!" and none present there had any idea why he had done so.[^1]
The Incident of Hadhrat Umar (RA) with Hadhrat Abu Mihjin Thaqafi (RA)

Hadhrat Abu Qilaabah narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) was once informed that Hadhrat Abu Mihjin Thaqafi (RA) and some of his friends were drinking wine at his house. Hadhrat Umar (RA) left and entered the house, finding only one person with Hadhrat Abu Mihjin (RA). Hadhrat Abu Mihjin (RA) said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! This is not at all permissible for you because Allaah has forbidden you from spying." "What is he saying?" asked Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA) and Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Arqam (RA) both agreed saying, "He is right, O Ameerul Mu'mineen! This falls into the category of spying." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then left him alone.[^2]
Hadhrat Umar (RA)'s Instructions to the Family of a Young Lady in this Regard

Hadhrat Sha'bi reports that a man once came to Hadhrat Umar (RA) saying, "I had a daughter whom I had buried alive during the Period of Ignorance. However, we then removed her from the ground before she died. Together with us, she then found the Period of Islaam and accepted Islaam. After accepting Islaam, she became liable for capital punishment for violating the law of Allaah. She then grabbed a dagger to kill herself but we managed to stop her after she had severed an artery. We then treated her and she has recovered. Subsequently, she has repented most sincerely. Now that she has received a proposal for marriage from a certain family, we have informed all about her past." Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Do you wish to expose that which Allaah has concealed? By Allaah! If you ever again inform anyone about her past, I shall make you a lesson for all the people of the many cities to learn from. Marry her as you would marry any chaste Muslim woman."[^3]

Hadhrat Sha'bi narrates that a woman was once punished for a crime of immorality. However, after her tribe had arrived as immigrants in Madinah, she repented very sincerely. When she received a proposal for marriage, her uncle did not approve of getting her married without first informing the people about her past.
